## Before asking for a merge

- [ ] Branched from current master, into master
- [ ] Not past the cap of 6 open agent pull requests (CLAUDE.md, "How work lands")
- [ ] Started from an issue chosen from `queue` (promoted to `ready`, or straight to `in-progress` with the claim), or one the owner named; claimed it (`ready` off, `in-progress` on, comment says why); body has `Fixes #N` (CLAUDE.md, "Work starts from an issue")
- [ ] One concern; each fix has a test that fails without it
- [ ] Every CI check green
- [ ] A file in decisions/ and one in progress/
